message.content:
The structure is reported in a primitive cubic input cell whose three lattice edges are carried by [[param:cell.a]], [[param:cell.b]], and [[param:cell.c]], with the interaxial angles given by [[param:cell.alpha]], [[param:cell.beta]], and [[param:cell.gamma]]; because the three edges match and the three angles are right angles, the input backbone is metrically cubic. The supplied cell contains [[param:input.atom_count]] atoms in all, distributed as [[param:composition.Ni]], [[param:composition.Sb]], and [[param:composition.Se]], so the input composition has equal counts of the three species within that cell.

The symmetry is the cubic space group identified by [[param:space_group.number]], with the Hall setting recorded as [[param:space_group.hall]]. In this setting the independent content reduces to three Wyckoff orbits, each labeled 4a and each having four symmetry-related positions generated from one free coordinate along the body-diagonal form x, x, x. The nickel orbit is identified as [[param:orbit.o000.id]], its species is [[param:orbit.o000.element]], its Wyckoff label is [[param:orbit.o000.wyckoff]], and its single positional parameter is [[param:orbit.o000.parameters]]. The antimony orbit is identified as [[param:orbit.o001.id]], with species [[param:orbit.o001.element]], Wyckoff label [[param:orbit.o001.wyckoff]], and free parameter [[param:orbit.o001.parameters]]. The selenium orbit is identified as [[param:orbit.o002.id]], with species [[param:orbit.o002.element]], Wyckoff label [[param:orbit.o002.wyckoff]], and free parameter [[param:orbit.o002.parameters]]. Thus all three independent atoms lie on the same type of threefold-related cubic site, but their free x parameters remain distinct and should not be treated as identical.

No change of coordinate frame is required between the supplied input and the standard description: the transformation matrix is [[param:frame.matrix]] and the origin shift is [[param:frame.origin_shift]], i.e. the identity rotation with no translation. Fractional input values are considered at the precision indicated by [[param:round_digits]]. No precision corrections were supplied, so there are no additional measured deviations from the idealized cubic P2_13 backbone to report beyond the stated distinct free coordinates and the stated rounding precision.
